article_text: The X200 supports up to 25 connected devices and ships with a 1-year warranty. Firmware updates install automatically overnight.
The X200 Pro supports up to 60 connected devices and ships with a 2-year warranty. It adds a dedicated 5GHz band for streaming and gaming.
The 410 camera is weatherproofed to an IP66 rating and stores up to 30 days of footage locally on its included SD card.
The T50 learns your schedule within about a week of normal use and typically reduces heating costs by 10 to 15 percent.
The starter kit ships with 4 bulbs and one hub. Additional bulbs can be added to the same hub without buying another one.
